label: ProductForge-Dashboard Backlog 92
title: Template gallery & selection UI (pipeline_templates)
body:
## Original (as captured)
Dashboard counterpart for the pipeline-phases program.

## Context (from linked item product_forge:BI-0116)
pipeline_templates/ (8 templates) + docs/schemas/pipeline-template.v1.schema.json + docs/PIPELINE-TEMPLATE-SPEC.md EXIST but are NOT wired (only the archived legacy dashboard consumed them; legacy review flagged them NOT_WIRED). Add a template registry + selection + project-pipeline generation into core/orchestrator + run_pipeline.py.
API-FIRST (owner convention): expose this capability through the backend API with a stable contract; the dashboard consumes ONLY the API (no direct store access/writes).
